articles.title_cn: 竞争环境中的信息销售
articles.abstract_en: Data buyers compete in a game of incomplete information about which a single data seller owns some payoff-relevant information. The seller faces a joint information- and mechanism-design problem: deciding which information to sell, while eliciting the buyers' types and imposing payments. We derive the welfare- and revenue-optimal mechanisms for a class of games with binary actions and states. Our results highlight the critical properties of selling information in competitive environments: (i) the negative externalities arising from buyer competition increase the profitability of recommending the correct action to one buyer exclusively; (ii) for the buyers to follow the seller's recommendations, the degree of exclusivity must be limited; (iii) the buyers' obedience constraints also reduce the distortions in the allocation of information introduced by a monopolist; (iv) as competition becomes fiercer, these limitations become more severe, weakening the impact of market power on the optimal allocation of information.
articles.abstract_cn: 数据购买者在一个不完全信息博弈中竞争，而一个单一的数据卖家拥有一些与收益相关的信息。卖家面临一个联合的信息与机制设计问题：决定销售哪些信息，同时诱导购买者的类型并施加支付。我们为一类具有二元行动和状态的博弈推导出福利和收入最优机制。我们的结果突出了在竞争环境中销售信息的关键特性：（i）购买者竞争产生的负外部性增加了向一个购买者独家推荐正确行动的盈利能力；（ii）为了让购买者遵循卖家的建议，排他性程度必须受到限制；（iii）购买者的服从约束也减少了垄断者在信息分配中引入的扭曲；（iv）随着竞争变得更加激烈，这些限制变得更加严重，削弱了市场力量对最优信息分配的影响。

articles.title_en: Asset pricing with time preference shocks: Existence and uniqueness
articles.title_cn: 时间偏好冲击下的资产定价：存在性与唯一性
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies existence and uniqueness of recursive utility in asset pricing models with time preference shocks. We provide conditions that clarify existence and uniqueness for a wide range of models, including exact necessary and sufficient conditions for standard formulations. The conditions isolate the roles of preference parameters, as well as the different risks that drive the consumption and preference shock processes. By deriving and decomposing a stability coefficient for recursive utility models, we show how different parameters in the model interact to determine existence and uniqueness of solutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有时间偏好冲击的资产定价模型中递归效用的存在性与唯一性。我们提供了条件，阐明了一系列广泛模型的存在性与唯一性，包括标准公式的精确必要且充分条件。这些条件隔离了偏好参数的作用，以及驱动消费和偏好冲击过程的不同风险。通过推导并分解递归效用模型的稳定性系数，我们展示了模型中不同参数如何相互作用以决定解的存在性与唯一性。

articles.title_cn: 信念依赖偏好的机制设计
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies mechanism design when agents have belief-dependent preferences, in that utilities depend on the agents' hierarchical posterior beliefs about types. For instance, agents may be subject to temptation, shame, image concerns, or privacy concerns. In this setting, the textbook revelation principle does not hold, since mechanisms can provide agents with information that affects posterior beliefs. This paper uses a psychological game framework suited for mechanism design, and provides a novel version of the revelation principle for belief-dependent preferences. The new revelation principle makes use of extended direct mechanisms that map each reported type into material outcomes and private suggestions of what posterior beliefs the agents should have. The paper shows that it suffices to use extended direct mechanisms that satisfy three conditions: Bayesian incentive compatibility, individual rationality, and a new condition called believability. The new revelation principle is used to find revenue-maximizing auctions when bidders have different types of image concerns. Moreover, it provides an alternate tool—distinct from Myerson's communication revelation principle—to study mechanism design with after-games.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当代理人具有信念依赖偏好时的机制设计，即效用依赖于代理人关于类型的层次后验信念。例如，代理人可能受到诱惑、羞耻、形象关注或隐私关注的影响。在这种设定下，教科书式的显示原理不再成立，因为机制可以向代理人提供影响后验信念的信息。本文采用了一种适合机制设计的心理博弈框架，并为信念依赖偏好提供了显示原理的新版本。新的显示原理利用了扩展的直接机制，该机制将每个报告的类型映射为物质结果和关于代理人应具有的后验信念的私人建议。本文表明，使用满足三个条件的扩展直接机制就足够了：贝叶斯激励相容、个体理性以及一个称为可信性的新条件。新的显示原理被用于在竞标者具有不同类型的形象关注时寻找收益最大化的拍卖。此外，它提供了一种替代工具——不同于迈尔森的沟通显示原理——来研究带有后续博弈的机制设计。

articles.title_en: Implementation in undominated strategies with applications to auction design, public good provision and matching
articles.title_cn: 非占优策略实施及其在拍卖设计、公共品供给和匹配中的应用
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers implementation in undominated strategies by finite mechanisms, where multiple outcomes may be implemented at a single state of the world. We establish a sufficient condition for implementation applicable in a general environment with private values. We apply it to three well-known environments and obtain strikingly permissive results. In the single-object auction, the second-price auction with a reserve price can be outperformed in terms of revenue. In the public good provision problem, the Vickrey–Clarke–Groves mechanism can be outperformed from the viewpoint of a designer who wishes to minimise deficit subject to efficiency. In the two-sided matching environment where preferences on one side of the market are private information, the social choice correspondence that outputs all stable matchings at every preference profile, is implementable.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑通过有限机制在非占优策略下实施，其中在单一世界状态下可能实施多个结果。我们建立了一个适用于具有私人价值的一般环境的充分条件。我们将其应用于三个众所周知的环境，并获得了令人惊讶的宽松结果。在单物品拍卖中，带有保留价格的第二价格拍卖在收入方面可能被超越。在公共品供给问题中，从希望以效率为约束最小化赤字的 designer 的角度来看，Vickrey–Clarke–Groves 机制可能被超越。在偏好为私人信息的两边匹配环境中，输出每个偏好配置下所有稳定匹配的社会选择对应关系是可实施的。

articles.title_en: The existence of universal qualitative belief spaces
articles.title_cn: 普遍定性信念空间的存在性
articles.abstract_en: This paper constructs a canonical representation of players' interactive beliefs, irrespective of natures of beliefs: whether beliefs are qualitative, truthful (i.e., knowledge), or probabilistic (e.g., countably-additive, finitely-additive, or non-additive). The canonical model is the “largest” interactive belief model to which any particular model can be mapped in a unique belief-preserving way. The key insight for the construction is the need to specify players' possible depth of reasoning up to which they can interactively reason about their beliefs (e.g., their beliefs, their beliefs about their beliefs, their beliefs about their beliefs about their beliefs, and so on). The possible depth of reasoning may be a transfinite level (beyond any finite level) when beliefs are qualitative. The specification of possible depth of reasoning also has game-theoretic implications for characterizations of some solution concepts using the canonical space. For instance, for any strategic game with ordinal payoffs, there exists a canonical interactive belief model which characterizes iterated elimination of strictly dominated actions as an implication of common belief in rationality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了玩家交互信念的规范表示，不论信念的性质如何：定性、真实（即知识）或概率（例如，可数可加、有限可加或不可加）。规范模型是“最大”的交互信念模型，任何特定模型都可以以唯一保持信念的方式映射到该模型。构建的关键洞见在于需要指定玩家可能的推理深度，即他们可以交互推理其信念的程度（例如，他们的信念、他们对其信念的信念、他们对其信念的信念的信念，等等）。当信念为定性时，可能的推理深度可以是超限水平（超越任何有限水平）。可能的推理深度的规范也对使用规范空间刻画某些解概念具有博弈论意义。例如，对于任何具有序数收益的策略博弈，存在一个规范交互信念模型，该模型将严格劣势行动的迭代消除刻画为理性共同信念的推论。

articles.title_en: Making predictions based on data: Holistic and atomistic procedures
articles.title_cn: 基于数据进行预测：整体性与原子性程序
articles.abstract_en: Subjects were asked to predict the choice made by a hypothetical individual, based on a small sample of his past choices in identical situations. Each of the alternatives facing the individual has a number of components. When the data is presented explicitly as a distribution of past choices, most subjects use the holistic procedure according to which the prediction is the most common choice made in the past. Nevertheless, a significant minority of subjects use atomistic procedures, which relate to the various components individually. When the distribution is not explicitly presented but can be derived from the data, subjects apply both atomistic procedures and holistic rules of thumb.
articles.abstract_cn: 受试者被要求根据一个假设个体在过去相同情境中的小样本选择，预测该个体将做出的选择。该个体面临的每个备选方案都有多个组成部分。当数据以过去选择的分布形式明确呈现时，大多数受试者采用整体性程序，即预测为过去最常做出的选择。然而，显著少数的受试者使用原子性程序，这些程序分别涉及各个组成部分。当分布未被明确呈现但可从数据中推导时，受试者同时应用原子性程序和整体性经验法则。

articles.abstract_en: In practice mediation operates through shuttle diplomacy: the mediator goes back and forth between parties, meeting them in private. We model shuttle diplomacy as a dynamic procedure. The mediator helps each party to gradually discover (privately) her value from settlement and re-assess her bargaining position, while also proposing the terms of the deal. We show that shuttle diplomacy always allows parties to achieve an ex-post efficient final settlement. In contrast, this is not possible with a static mediation procedure. In addition, if parties have symmetric prior value distributions, shuttle diplomacy guarantees a fair split of the social value from settlement.
articles.abstract_cn: 在实践中，调解通过穿梭外交运作：调解人在各方之间来回穿梭，私下会见他们。我们将穿梭外交建模为一个动态程序。调解人帮助每一方逐步（私下）发现其和解价值并重新评估其谈判地位，同时提出交易条款。我们表明，穿梭外交总是能让各方达成事后有效的最终和解。相比之下，静态调解程序则无法实现这一点。此外，如果各方具有对称的先验价值分布，穿梭外交能保证从和解中获得的社会价值的公平分配。

articles.title_en: A simple and general axiomatization of average utility maximization for infinite streams
articles.title_cn: 平均效用最大化在无限流上的一个简单而一般的公理化
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides the most general preference axiomatization of average utility (AU) maximization over infinite sequences presently available, reaching almost complete generality. The only restriction is that all periodic sequences should be contained in the domain. Infinite sequences may designate intertemporal outcomes streams where AU models patience, welfare allocations where AU models fairness, or decisions under ambiguity where AU models complete ignorance. As a methodological contribution, this paper shows that infinite-dimensional representations can be simpler, rather than more complex, than finite-dimensional ones. Infinite dimensions provide a richness that may be convenient rather than cumbersome. In particular, (empirically problematic) continuity assumptions are not needed in our axiomatization. Continuity is optional.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了目前可用的关于无限序列上平均效用（AU）最大化的最一般的偏好公理化，达到了几乎完全的普遍性。唯一的限制是所有周期序列都应包含在定义域中。无限序列可以表示跨期结果流，其中AU模拟耐心；福利分配，其中AU模拟公平；或模糊性下的决策，其中AU模拟完全无知。作为方法论贡献，本文表明无限维表示可以比有限维表示更简单，而不是更复杂。无限维度提供了丰富性，这可能是有利的而非累赘。特别是，（经验上有问题的）连续性假设在我们的公理化中并不需要。连续性是可选的。

articles.abstract_en: Informational separability occurs when information decreases as the result of suppressing information that differentiates a subset of states in experiments. With multiple states, informational separability leads to entropy measures. Its implications in multiple different contexts are discussed, including segregation measurement, inference with partial information, and rational inattention.
articles.abstract_cn: 当抑制实验中区分状态子集的信息导致信息减少时，即出现信息可分性。在多种状态下，信息可分性引致熵度量。本文讨论了其在多个不同情境中的含义，包括隔离度量、部分信息下的推断以及理性疏忽。

articles.abstract_en: Absence of a shared language is an evident barrier to effective communication. Lack of common knowledge of what is shared is more insidious and a potential source of misunderstandings. We induce lack of common knowledge of a shared language in a sender-receiver game experiment by letting the availability of messages with focal meanings be uncertain. We consider an environment in which agents agree on the optimal action in every state of the world, there are equilibria in which messages with focal meanings are used in accordance with those meanings, and these equilibria maximize both sender and receiver payoffs. We do find, however, that these equilibria are fragile: Observed behavior aligns better with pooling equilibria, in which receivers ignore messages. This effect is more pronounced when the pooling action is optimal for a larger set of receiver beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 缺乏共同语言是有效沟通的明显障碍。对共享内容缺乏共同知识则更为隐蔽，并可能成为误解的根源。我们在一个发送者-接收者博弈实验中，通过让具有焦点含义的消息的可用性变得不确定，来诱导对共享语言缺乏共同知识。我们考虑了一个环境，其中代理在世界每个状态下都同意最优行动，存在均衡，其中具有焦点含义的消息按照这些含义使用，并且这些均衡使发送者和接收者的收益都最大化。然而，我们确实发现这些均衡是脆弱的：观察到的行为更符合汇集均衡，其中接收者忽略消息。当汇集行动对更大范围的接收者信念集为最优时，这种效应更为显著。

articles.title_en: Strategic limitation of market accessibility: Search platform design and welfare
articles.title_cn: 市场可达性的策略性限制：搜索平台设计与福利
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the relationship between market accessibility and various participants' welfare in an intermediated directed-search market. For a general class of meeting technologies, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition under which efficiency requires imperfect accessibility, such that each seller's listing is only observed by some but not all buyers. We show that the platform optimally implements the efficient outcome, but fully extracts surplus from the transactions it intermediates. We also find that in general, buyers prefer to minimize market accessibility, while sellers prefer a weakly greater accessibility level than that which is socially efficient. The efficiency of imperfect accessibility is robust to the introduction of a second chance for unmatched buyers to search.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了在中间商主导的定向搜索市场中，市场可达性与各类参与者福利之间的关系。对于一类一般的匹配技术，我们提供了效率要求不完全可达性的充分必要条件，即每个卖家的列表仅被部分而非全部买家观察到。我们表明，平台最优地实现了有效结果，但完全提取了其中介交易的剩余。我们还发现，一般而言，买家倾向于最小化市场可达性，而卖家则倾向于比社会有效水平稍高的可达性水平。不完全可达性的效率对于引入未匹配买家的第二次搜索机会是稳健的。

articles.title_en: The network origins of the gains from trade
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a network perspective on the gains from trade in today's international supply chains. In particular, we demonstrate that the comparative statics predictions of a standard general-equilibrium trade model with input-output linkages can be expressed as a network diffusion model. This model captures the relevant dimensions of the production network's structure by just two easily quantifiable statistics: A country's upstream exposure to supply shocks further up in the network and its downstream exposure to demand shocks further down. We then show how up- and downstream exposure crucially determine the welfare effects from various types of trade cost shocks. In some cases, they even capture the entire welfare effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文从网络视角探讨当今国际供应链中的贸易收益。具体而言，我们证明了一个具有投入产出联系的标准一般均衡贸易模型的比较静态预测可以表示为网络扩散模型。该模型仅通过两个易于量化的统计量来捕捉生产网络结构的相关维度：一国对网络中更上游供应冲击的上游暴露度，以及其对更下游需求冲击的下游暴露度。然后，我们展示了上游和下游暴露度如何关键地决定各类贸易成本冲击的福利效应。在某些情况下，它们甚至能完全捕捉整个福利效应。

articles.title_en: Monotone equilibrium in matching markets with signaling
articles.title_cn: 带信号传递的匹配市场中的单调均衡
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a notion of competitive signaling equilibrium (CSE) in one-to-one matching markets with a continuum of heterogeneous senders and receivers. We then study monotone CSE where equilibrium outcomes - sender actions, receiver reactions, beliefs, and matching - are all monotone in the stronger set order. We show that if the sender utility is monotone-supermodular and the receiver's utility is weakly monotone-supermodular, a CSE is stronger monotone if and only if it passes Criterion D1 (Cho and Kreps (1987), Banks and Sobel (1987)). Given any interval of feasible reactions that receivers can take, we fully characterize a unique stronger monotone CSE and establishes its existence with quasilinear utility functions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在具有连续异质性发送者和接收者的一对一匹配市场中引入了竞争性信号传递均衡（CSE）的概念。然后我们研究单调CSE，其中均衡结果——发送者行动、接收者反应、信念和匹配——都在更强的集合序下是单调的。我们证明，如果发送者效用是单调超模的，且接收者效用是弱单调超模的，那么一个CSE是更强单调的当且仅当它通过准则D1（Cho和Kreps（1987），Banks和Sobel（1987））。给定接收者可以采取的任何可行反应区间，我们完全刻画了一个唯一的更强单调CSE，并在拟线性效用函数下确立了其存在性。

articles.title_cn: 匹配问题中的单边稳定性
articles.abstract_en: The canonical solution concept used in matching problems is pairwise stability, whose premise is that harmony is disrupted by any two agents intentionally leaving their partners to be with each other. We instead focus on scenarios in which harmony is disrupted merely by a single agent unilaterally initiating contact with a member of a different pair, whether or not his approach is reciprocated. A variety of solution concepts are proposed in which taboos, status, or power systematically limit such initiatives in order to achieve harmony.
articles.abstract_cn: 匹配问题中使用的经典解概念是两两稳定性，其前提是任何两个代理人故意离开各自的伴侣而彼此结合会破坏和谐。我们转而关注这样一种情景：和谐仅仅因单个代理人单方面主动接触另一对中的某个成员而被破坏，无论其主动是否得到回应。我们提出了多种解概念，在这些概念中，禁忌、地位或权力系统地限制此类主动行为，以实现和谐。

articles.title_en: Expectational equilibria in many-to-one matching models with contracts
articles.title_cn: 带合同的多对一匹配模型中的预期均衡
articles.abstract_en: We introduce the notion of expectational equilibrium in a general specification of the many-to-one matching with contracts model. The endogenous variables in an expectational equilibrium are expectations about tradable contracts. Expectational equilibrium outcomes are equivalent to stable outcomes. Expectational equilibrium unifies all the other approaches used in the literature so far, in particular Walrasian equilibrium, Drèze equilibrium, and market clearing cutoffs. It also applies to cases where contracts do not involve money as well as cases where there is a smallest monetary unit of account.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在带合同的多对一匹配模型的一般规范中引入了预期均衡的概念。预期均衡中的内生变量是关于可交易合同的预期。预期均衡结果与稳定结果等价。预期均衡统一了迄今为止文献中使用的所有其他方法，特别是瓦尔拉斯均衡、德雷兹均衡和市场出清截止点。它也适用于合同不涉及货币的情况，以及存在最小货币记账单位的情况。
